exposure: Uterine artery chemoembolisation (UAC) with methotrexate and gelatine sponge
cohort: Forty-one patients diagnosed with caesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who underwent selective endovascular chemoembolisation of uterine arteries.
finding: Uterine artery chemoembolisation (UAC) was found to be a safe and effective method for CSP treatment, especially for fertility preservation, with procedural failures often linked to collateral blood supply or uterine artery reperfusion.
